I told myself I resented this, yet when I found he had quietly oiled the oldest pendulum before dawn, I could not hold on to my anger. Carmela, his wife, said he did it every morning and pretended he didn't. Slowly I began to see that my brother's restlessness was its own kind of loyalty, one that would rather leave than stand by and watch the shop fail. Do you remember the night bus to Kadikoy, Mr. Nikos? I doubt you knew I was sitting three rows behind you. For a whole term I had not said one word in your class, and you had stopped calling on me, which I took as a judgment. g.passage: Seven stitches to a signature, my father used to say, and not one more. On the tenth anniversary of his death I went to Yuying, his oldest friend and the finest bookbinder in our quarter of Shanghai, to ask her help with a lantern ceremony grand enough to be talked about.
